about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Free community Quran app
about.aboutUsContent: Recite is a non-profit, 100% free community project dedicated to making the Holy Quran accessible to everyone worldwide with zero ads, subscriptions, or paywalls.
about.aboutAppIntro: Built using high-performance open-source technologies, Recite provides authentic verse recitations, side-by-side multi-language translations, and instant search in a modern interface.
about.featureRecitersDesc: High-quality audio from world-renowned Qaris with verse-by-verse playback.
about.featureLanguagesDesc: Read side-by-side verse translations across multiple global languages.
about.featurePrivacyDesc: No tracking, ad profiling, or personal data collection required.
about.tagline: Read, Listen & Reflect upon the Quran
